candidate_evidence.quote: Patients receive tipifarnib tablets 350 mg/m\^2/dose PO or via nasogastric or gastric tube BID

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: solid tumors that have recurred or spread to other places in the body (advanced)

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Tipifarnib may block the growth of cancer cells that have specific genetic changes in a gene called HRAS

source_quote.quote: Phase 2 Subprotocol of Tipifarnib in Patients With Tumors Harboring HRAS Genomic Alterations

coder_notes: Pediatric MATCH basket (ages 12 months to 21 years). Glioblastoma is not named anywhere; only malignant glioma and WHO grade 2 glioma in conditions, so coded high_grade_glioma_unspecified (excluded at S5).
